immutable_input.history_note: The previously proposed EXACT_DELTA_VALUE next gate remains historical record in c20; this successor refinement does not delete or rewrite it.

imported_from_c20: For the separation-safe z_r=rho+epsilon_r, sign(p_child(z_r)) is positive iff the child is good and negative iff it is bad.

cases.Delta_positive: If Delta_s(z_r)>0 then p_s0(z_r)=p_s(z_r)+(1-alpha_s)Delta_s(z_r)>p_s(z_r)>0, so child 0 is good.
cases.Delta_zero: If Delta_s(z_r)=0 then p_s0(z_r)=p_s1(z_r)=p_s(z_r)>0; both are good and frozen tie order chooses child 0.
cases.Delta_negative: If Delta_s(z_r)<0 then p_s1(z_r)=p_s(z_r)-alpha_s Delta_s(z_r)>p_s(z_r)>0, so child 1 is good.

SIGN_ONLY_REDUCTION_PROOF.conclusion: sgn(Delta_s(z_r)) alone is sufficient to deterministically identify a good child at every genuine binary HPS node reachable under the good-prefix invariant.

CARRIED_PARENT_VALUE_ELIMINATION.inductive_semantics: CURRENT_PREFIX_IS_GOOD => p_s(z_r)>0; the sign-only child rule preserves goodness; therefore no exact parent scalar need be carried through descent.
CARRIED_PARENT_VALUE_ELIMINATION.root_requirement: The root need only be certified good by the already imported HPS/root bound; its exact value at z_r is not required by this sign-only selector rule.

FROZEN_SIGN_ORACLE_TARGET.statement: For every integer r>=1 and every reachable good prefix s in the frozen HPS decision order, deterministically decide the exact three-way sign of Delta_s(z_r)=p_s0(z_r)-p_s1(z_r) in r^O(1) bit operations and r^O(1) space.
FROZEN_SIGN_ORACLE_TARGET.degenerate_factor_rule: If the next HPS factor is deterministic/degenerate rather than genuinely binary, advance it without invoking the sign oracle.
FROZEN_SIGN_ORACLE_TARGET.runtime: r^O(1) bit operations with exponent independent of r
FROZEN_SIGN_ORACLE_TARGET.zero_case: Must decide exact ZERO; approximation or unresolved near-zero is not acceptable.

PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.object: Represent the conditioned HPS future randomness and the sibling difference as a structured group-algebra/partial-permutation sum, then evaluate only the sign-relevant scalar at z_r.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.exact_property_needed: The exact HPS Delta-sign object reduces to polynomially many exact character evaluations or equivalent partial-permutation statistics.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.good_child_implication: Only via the frozen sign-only reduction theorem above.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.bit_complexity_target: All character weights, multiplicities and algebraic evaluations have polynomial bit length.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.bridge: Hamaker-Rhoades partial-permutation character evaluation is relevant representation machinery but is not imported as an HPS sign-oracle theorem.
PARTIAL_PERMUTATION_CHARACTER_ROUTE.killer_falsifier: The exact HPS sibling difference requires superpolynomially many character components/orbit types or the partial-permutation sum representation is not closed under the frozen next-swap semantics.

JUCYS_MURPHY_ROUTE.object: Use Jucys-Murphy/star-transposition algebra matching the recursive HPS swap factors to derive an exact finite operator state for the sibling sign.
JUCYS_MURPHY_ROUTE.exact_property_needed: Closure of the conditioned sibling-difference observable under successive frozen star/rank-1 swap factors inside a polynomial-size algebraic state.
JUCYS_MURPHY_ROUTE.killer_falsifier: Noncommuting factors force an unbounded hierarchy whose exact basis dimension is superpolynomial in r.

LOW_RANK_DELTA_ROUTE.object: Exploit that sibling leaf matrices differ by constant-rank updates and target the determinant difference at z_r rather than either determinant separately.
LOW_RANK_DELTA_ROUTE.exact_property_needed: An exact averaged determinant-difference identity closed under all future random swaps using only polynomially many correlation quantities.
LOW_RANK_DELTA_ROUTE.good_child_implication: The sign of the resulting Delta_s(z_r) selects the child.
LOW_RANK_DELTA_ROUTE.known_limit_from_c20: Naive determinant/adjugate state is not closed after the first overlapping future swap because higher compound-minor correlations appear.
LOW_RANK_DELTA_ROUTE.killer_falsifier: Any proposed finite low-rank state fails at an explicit reachable overlapping-support prefix because two states with identical compressed data produce different future Delta signs.

FIXED_BASE_DP_ROUTE.object: A fixed-base dynamic program with combinatorial dimension depending only on the 186-vertex/465-edge STS31 base and coordinates ranging polynomially with r.
FIXED_BASE_DP_ROUTE.allowed_state_count: r^C for fixed C independent of r
forbidden_state_count: partition-number-type superpolynomial state unless further compressed
FIXED_BASE_DP_ROUTE.exact_equivalence_required: SAME_COMPRESSED_STATE => SAME_FUTURE_DELTA_SIGN, or a stronger exact equivalence sufficient to decide the oracle.
FIXED_BASE_DP_ROUTE.BA16_firewall: PATH_MULTIPLICITY != IDENTITY_MULTIPLICITY; occupancy similarity alone does not license identity collapse.
FIXED_BASE_DP_ROUTE.killer_falsifier: First reachable pair of prefixes with identical proposed DP state but opposite exact future Delta sign.

FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.test_rule: For each proposed compressed state, identify the earliest reachable prefix where the next overlapping-support swap may require information not present in the state.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.baseline_break_from_c20: The naive determinant-plus-local-cofactor state breaks at the first overlapping future random swap because higher compound/cross-minor information is needed.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.preferred_killer_test: Construct the earliest overlapping-support prefix, not a large empirical prefix sweep.
FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK.stop_rule: When closure fails, freeze the exact missing statistic immediately; do not patch by silently enlarging to an exponential state.

HRAIN_RED_TEAM.rule: Failure of one route or state representation does not falsify the frozen sign-oracle target.

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.object: Exact group-algebra representation of sibling conditioned difference
INAIHR_CANDIDATES.required_return: Exact reduction to polynomially many character evaluations

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.object: Polynomial-size operator algebra for recursive star transpositions

INAIHR_CANDIDATES.required_return: Polynomial correlation closure under future overlapping swaps

Exact correctness and polynomial bit complexity

PASS_FAIL_OPEN_CRITERIA.PASS: A theorem plus deterministic algorithm decides NEGATIVE/ZERO/POSITIVE for Delta_s(z_r) for every reachable good prefix in r^O(1) bit operations and r^O(1) space, including exact zero handling.
PASS_FAIL_OPEN_CRITERIA.OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER: No route proves the sign oracle and no rigorous impossibility theorem falsifies the whole frozen target.
PASS_FAIL_OPEN_CRITERIA.FAIL: Only a rigorous falsifier of the entire frozen sign-decision target under the exact frozen semantics; failure of one representation is not FAIL.
PASS_FAIL_OPEN_CRITERIA.post_PASS_firewall: SIGN_DELTA_NODE_ORACLE=PROVED would still not automatically prove selector A; a separate full-composition gate remains mandatory.

COMPLEXITY_CONTRACT.algebraic_point: z_r=rho+epsilon_r with rho=sqrt(14)+sqrt(2) and epsilon_r inherited from c20 separation-safe construction

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Prove or falsify only the frozen exact three-way sign oracle for Delta_s(z_r) on every reachable good HPS prefix of the fixed STS31 base. Do not execute automatically; do not promote selector A without a later composition gate.
